moon.note: Water ice is detected in permanently shadowed polar craters; regolith is rich in silicates and metals.

mars.note: Water ice below the surface and in polar caps; thin carbon dioxide atmosphere; dust storms.

mercury.note: Extreme temperatures; water ice indicated in polar craters.

venus.note: Surface is far too hot and the pressure crushing; no surface facility is possible.

europa.note: Subsurface ocean beneath an ice shell; intense radiation from Jupiter.

enceladus.note: Water-ice plumes from a subsurface ocean.

titan.note: Thick nitrogen atmosphere and methane lakes; very cold.

ceres.note: Largest asteroid-belt body with a water-rich crust.
